about.title: About Me
about.text: I'm a 21-year-old recently graduated in Systems Analysis and Development, and I love the world of technology and art! I've always been a very creative person, and I found in programming a way to unite my two passions. I like to develop software, websites, apps and games, and also create digital art, illustrations and animations. I believe that technology can be a powerful tool to transform the world, and I want to contribute to this with my work and artistic vision.

desu.title: DESU
desu.description: An AI-powered Japanese learning app designed for anime and Japanese culture enthusiasts. This innovative language course generates personalized lessons and progress sections through artificial intelligence, creating a highly tailored learning experience for each user.
keyAchievements: Developed complex screens and features in <bold>React Native with Expo</bold> and <bold>TypeScript</bold>
Built responsive and animated landing pages with <bold>Next.js</bold> and <bold>shadcn/ui</bold>
Implemented <bold>internationalization</bold> with <bold>i18n</bold>
Active participation in design process, creating illustrations, animations, and screens using <bold>Figma</bold>, <bold>Illustrator</bold>, and <bold>Photoshop</bold>
Worked with SVG rendering and styling on native platform using <bold>Skia library</bold>, <bold>React reusables</bold>, and <bold>NativeWind</bold>
Developed gamified backend features with <bold>tRPC</bold>, <bold>Nest.js</bold>, and <bold>Docker PostgreSQL/Neo4j/MongoDB</bold> container
Worked in a <bold>monorepo environment</bold> with <bold>Turborepo</bold>
Built AI-powered features, mainly chatbots using <bold>LangChain</bold> and <bold>Vercel AI SDK</bold>
Participated in <bold>Scrum rituals</bold> including dailies, reviews, and planning sessions
Developed features for <bold>browser extensions</bold>
Created automated tests using <bold>Jest</bold> and <bold>Vitest</bold>
Documented frontend components through <bold>Storybook</bold>

mogo.title: mogo
mogo.description: Mogo is a digital system designed to analyze and evaluate urban accessibility in the city of Praia Grande. Using Google Street View images and map data, the project identifies accessibility elements (such as ramps, tactile paving, and other essential structures) and assigns star ratings to routes, establishments, and tourist attractions.
keyAchievements: Built a comprehensive <bold>urban accessibility analysis system</bold> for Praia Grande using <bold>Google Street View</bold> and <bold>Google Maps APIs</bold>
Developed mobile application with <bold>React Native</bold> and <bold>Expo</bold>, featuring native maps integration
Implemented AI-powered accessibility detection system using <bold>YOLOv8</bold> to identify ramps, tactile paving, and essential structures
Created star-rating classification system for routes, establishments, and tourist attractions
Built backend with <bold>Python</bold> and <bold>Django REST Framework</bold> for data processing and API management
Implemented modern state management using <bold>Zustand</bold> and <bold>TanStack Query</bold>
Designed complete user experience using <bold>Figma</bold> and <bold>Adobe Illustrator</bold>
Integrated real-time location services with <bold>Expo Location</bold> and <bold>Google Places Autocomplete</bold>
Styled with <bold>NativeWind</bold> (Tailwind CSS for React Native) for consistent design system
Focused on <bold>inclusive design principles</bold> to serve the accessibility community effectively

yr432.title: YR432
yr432.description: YR432 is a cellular simulation game set in a hospital environment. You take control of a precision biomedical operator, tasked with saving a patient infected with a "common flu". Manage medications, combat the infection, and make decisions that can lead to a cure... or the end.
keyAchievements: Developed a <bold>real-time strategy game</bold> with cellular simulation in hospital environment using <bold>Unity</bold> and <bold>C#</bold>
Implemented <bold>A* pathfinding algorithm</bold> for intelligent cell movement and behavior
Created all <bold>game illustrations and animations</bold> from scratch using <bold>Adobe Photoshop</bold>
Designed <bold>sound effects and audio</bold> to enhance game immersion
Built complex <bold>medication management system</bold> with real-time decision-making mechanics
Developed <bold>narrative-driven gameplay</bold> with multiple endings based on player performance
Implemented <bold>dynamic dialogue system</bold> with custom expressions and character interactions
Created <bold>dynamic soundtrack</bold> that responds to game events and tension
Designed game architecture with <bold>ScriptableObjects</bold> for flexible data management
Implemented robust <bold>object-oriented design</bold> with clean architecture principles in C#
Developed as project for <bold>Software Engineering Lab</bold> at university
